fufu 0.19.3 is a patch release. Resolution sessions now account for every conflict, including files that can't take markers and files one side moved, and keep edits made outside the markers. [`ff restack --onto`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/restack/) and [`ff fold`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/fold/) replay only the branch's own commits, and [`ff describe -b`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/describe/) carries everything recorded under the branch's name.

## Resolution sessions

A modify/delete or binary conflict keeps your version and is listed apart from the marked files, with `ff restore <path> --from <base>` to take the other side. A file one side moved and the other edited takes markers at its new path. Edits outside the markers stay in the working copy when [`ff done`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/done/) rolls the session to another round, and land with the final round. [`ff resolve`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/resolve/) on a restack held at the open change moves the branch and lays the open change over the new tip in one operation. See [held rewrites](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/concepts/held-rewrites/).

## Which commits replay

`ff restack --onto` replays the commits above the branch's current base, as `git rebase --onto <new-base> <current-base>` does, including onto a base beneath the branch. `ff fold` into a branch other than trunk lands the source's commits that are not on trunk, so folding a fix into a release branch no longer brings unreleased trunk work along.

## Renaming a branch

`ff describe -b` moves the branch's seen and published records, its hold, and every other branch's record naming it. `ff undo` puts all of it back under the old name.

## Miscellaneous

- [`ff push`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/push/) and [`ff branch -d --shared`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/branch/) replace or delete a shared copy with no seen record, or a stale one, when the branch's own reflog shows it holding that tip.
- The [OpenCode plugin](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/opencode/) loads on OpenCode 2.x.
- Status, diff, and the verbs that move the working copy handle gitlinks, including an embedded repository a snapshot picked up.
- Snapshots see files under a directory that replaced a tracked file, and `ff undo` turns such a directory back into a file.
- On Windows, [`ff update`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/update/) recognizes an `install.ps1` install, and `ff resolve` handles a conflict between a file and a directory.
- Snapshots taken at once no longer fail on a shared temp file or mint two change ids.
- `ff undo` then `ff redo` of a partial `ff commit -b` keeps the remainder's change id.
